source_basis: The abstract opens with an escalating-verb aim sentence and closes with a keyword index longer than the prose.
interpretation: The escalation pattern (analyze, evaluate, explore) assigns each verb to a different task and creates a sense of increasing depth.
applicability: F papers that must preview multiple independent tasks in one sentence.

source_basis: Every coefficient is reported in a fixed four-beat order: value and test statistic, significance verdict, plain-language reading, robustness remark.
interpretation: The four-beat order never varies across the three rows, which makes each claim auditable and quotable.
applicability: Any regression result block in an MCM/ICM paper.

source_basis: Strengths are heading-plus-justification blocks; limitations are double-hedged, once in the heading and once in the body.
interpretation: The double-hedge pattern acknowledges weakness without undermining the overall claim.
applicability: Any evaluation or strengths-limitations section.

source_basis: Difference-in-differences multi-level linear regression with country random effects.
interpretation: The design separates the policy effect from the time trend and absorbs country heterogeneity in a random intercept.
applicability: Policy evaluation in cross-country panel data.

source_basis: Log-enhanced quadratic regression with one squared term certified twice.
interpretation: The double certification (metric comparison and the added term's own p-value) makes the model-improvement argument stronger than a single test.
applicability: Regression model selection in any problem type.

source_basis: Weighted composite scoring index with five stated weights summing to one.
interpretation: Stated weights make the aggregation auditable, but the unstated standardisation method limits reproducibility.
applicability: Any composite-index construction.

source_basis: Sensitivity curves holding two of three predictors at their mean.
interpretation: The holding condition is stated in the prose, which is better than unstated, but the figure does not print it.
applicability: Sensitivity analysis for any multi-predictor regression.

source_basis: Visual parallel-trends check with no formal test.

applicability: Any difference-in-differences design.
